title: Abaddon's Gate
author: James S. A. Corey
summary: Third in a space-opera series about humanity spread across the solar system. A vast alien structure appears beyond the outer planets, and ships from Earth, Mars and the Belt converge on it, each wary of the others.
readIf: you like a series that turns a first-contact mystery into a political pressure cooker.
skipIf: you want a standalone story, because the cast and tensions build on earlier books.

pairings.reason: The series opener, if you want the crew and the politics set up properly before this installment.
Another crew sent to explore a giant, silent alien structure, in a calmer and more awestruck register.
A bigger, stranger space story where strangers are drawn toward an unknown structure with a dark reputation.
